items.title: Looks nice and works well
items.content: This is exactly what we needed in our new kitchen and looks and feels very nice. However I wish it had big grips to keep it from sliding in the drawer. I added a liner to the drawer to help that issue.

items.title: The perfect match!

items.title: Great expandable bamboo kitchen organizer!
items.content: Good quality! Functional. I love the fact that the two side are expandable so will fit to your perfectly. I wash it before using. It only has six rubber stopper to be put on the backside of the kitchen organizer. Would be better if it has eight because each side of the expandable drawer should have a rubber pad. Minor point!

items.title: Expandable Bamboo silverware organizer
items.content: I personally love this for the kitchen drawer. I love that it expanded to fit my silverware.I have a 6 piece set up and there is one other space for extras. Bamboo is a better look than the plastic, in my opinion.

items.title: Solid and sturdy
items.content: This a one piece replaced three separate pieces I had in my silverware drawer. It’s expandable so that part is great. And there is weight to it so it doesn’t slide around like the cheap plastic ones do.

items.title: Nice silverware organizer
items.content: Love it! Wasn't as deep of brown that it seemed in the picture, but it's still a keeper.

items.title: Extendable Bamboo Utensil Drawer
items.content: Love it. This was nicely packaged and easy to use-no assembly required. The extended adjustability of the drawers makes sizing to your needs seem less. Beautiful rich bamboo color and easy to wipe off for cleaning.

items.title: Keeps Everything Neat
items.content: I’ve been really happy with this bamboo drawer organizer. It’s sturdy, easy to adjust, and fits my kitchen drawer perfectly. It helped keep my utensils organized and made everything much easier to find. I also love the natural bamboo look—it gives the drawer a clean, elegant feel.

items.title: Bamboo expandable insert for utensils
items.content: Worked perfectly. Have a large utensil drawer and could not find the product I wanted. Purchased the wood the expandable bamboo kitchen drawer. Had to place sideways in drawer so it would fit flush and it worked. Very pleased.
